svg.aria-label: Multi-cloud observability and self-healing. Grafana Alloy on AKS, EKS, GKE, DOKS and LiveKit media nodes ships metrics, logs, traces and security events through private endpoints into a hub VNet: an Alloy gateway feeds Mimir, Loki and Tempo, backed by object storage and PVC write-ahead logs. Grafana SLO burn-rate alerts route through a NAT gateway to PagerDuty and Slack, and self-healing actions (rollback, autoscaling, restarts) close the loop back to the workloads.

closed loop: detect → page → auto-remediate → verify → RCA
